characters.name: 1st generation as a whole
characters.description: The Friends Who Never Hang: Due to being the first attempt at a group, not much was done to foster a group identity. The girls were left on their own, and as a result they each did their own thing with the successes and troubles they had further determining things. Fubuki & Matsuri, Matsuri & Aki and Haato & Matsuri are pretty much the only pairings to avert this. The build up to the "From1st" concert also saw them collabing in a group as a rare aversion to this.

characters.name: Shirakami Fubuki
characters.description: A perky white kitsune and self-confessedotaku, Fubuki is a well of energy whose unabashed nerdiness and bright, extroverted personality has made her into something of a pillar of strength for hololive, able to bring people together and get along with just about everyone. She has a noted love of burgers,TTRPGsand superheroes, both of the traditional Western andHenshin Herovarieties. The Ace: This applies to her in terms of general gaming, either doing well off the bat or learning to do so quickly. It's likely it was her general interest and skill in games that had her made leader of Hololive GAMERS. Adorable Fluffy Tail: Has a fluffy white tail with a black tip. It is extremely poofy and has a white star on it. Animal Motifs: Foxes. Animorphism: She took the form of a regular fox in the beginning of her2020 New Year's outfit debut stream, and was later shown to be able to transform back into human form at will.

characters.name: Natsuiro Matsuri
characters.description: A high-school cheerleader, Matsuri quickly gained a reputation after her debut for her rowdy, raunchy and frequently perverted antics, being arguably the first in hololive to try and push the boundaries of what was considered acceptable at the time and helping to give hololive it's own identity in its early years. While she is unashamedly a massive pervert, Matsuri has a good heart deep down, and cares immensely about her friends. She's also openly pansexual, though she leans slightly more towards girls than guys, and even once half-jokingly said she wouldn't mind dating non-humans either. Absurdly Youthful Mother:Matsuri's actual mother is 51, but she can stillsound cutesy enoughto pass off as her older sister. It's to the point where fans have joked that Matsuri is just a clone of her mother. Apparently, the extremely youthful-looking avatar Mamatsuri uses on stream isactually how she looks. Actually Pretty Funny: During her collaboration with Coco's Reddit Meme reviews, she bursts out laughing with thebad Japaneseused by the Reddit memers. "Yametekudastop" in particular sets her lungs in orbit. Aggressive Submissive: Despite her very open advances towards her colleagues, she freezes up the moment someone reciprocates or takes the lead. This has happened with Choco in an ASMR stream as well as with Luna;she deniesthat Luna is more dominant than her, citing her lack of stamina, but when roleplaying out a love confession scene, Matsuri gets easily flustered when Luna plays along and encourages her to go for the kiss. Ain't Too Proud to Beg: Her infamousProject Wintercollaboration where she was at the receiving end of aCurb-Stomp Battleat the hands of Suisei has her begging for her life after the latter has slaughteredher entire Survivor team(sans Watame, who dies by herself) while Suisei steals Fubuki's clothes and imitates her just to rub salt to the wound. Shedid notforget about this whenever they collaborate in other multiplayer games.

characters.name: Aki Rosenthal
characters.description: A half-elf, half-siren from the far-off land of Sha-Le-Ys, Aki is a reserved, feminine girl who's very good at dancing (particularly belly dancing). She's also a surprisingly heavy drinker, with a preference for beer and barley juice above anything else. Anime Hair: Her trademark twintails are separated and float behind the rest of her hair, which is styled in a perfectly sensible bob cut. Another Dimension: Sha-Le-Ys, her hometown, isan elven countryin another universe. The Beastmaster: InARK: Survival Evolved, she has a rather large group of tamed dinosaurs to use as mounts and has tried to tame other creatures as pets. Big Good: With the 2022 resurgence ofARK: Survival Evolved, Aki became a major guiding force of various new players to the level of earning an NPC status akin to Moona.

This part of the character page goes over general tropes applying to one or more of these personalities. characters.name: Haachama
characters.description: Adam Westing: While she might be genuinely bad at cooking, she has jokingly started playing it upto absurd degreesas part of her image, even incorporating the "HaatoBasic" meme in her videos. Ambiguous Situation: Herwhole existenceis one. It is strongly implied thatHaachama, Haato's sister, died in an accident, but that does not explain exactly what the Haachama we see today evenis. While it is often assumed that "Haachama" is aSplit Personalitydeveloped by Haato, perhaps as a coping mechanism, it's not implausible that Haachama isa ghost haunting and possessing her sister, or evensomething else entirelythat just happens to take on the name and appearance of Haachama. Haachama herself also plays into this at times, for example her background for Haachama Cooking features a shoddy brick wall crawling with spiders. characters.name: Yozora Mel
characters.description: A vampire student from the underworld known for her good looks and keen mind, though her bizarre train of thought often calls the latter into question. She's mortified by the sight of blood, an inconvenient (andironic) fear for a vampire, though she's able to make do by using acerola juice as a substitute.Mel's contract was terminated on January 16th, 2024 when she accidentally leaked confidential information to third parties. Her channel was made private by the end of February 2024. Adaptational Skimpiness: Her default 3D outfit shows more skin than her 2D outfits. She is noticeably the only hololive member to wear a different outfit in their default 3D model from their original 2D one. Affectionate Nickname: She is called "Yossan" by Subaru at her own request. To the duck's embarrassment, she's the only person to call Mel by that. Afraid of Blood: Ironic, considering she's a vampire. Apparently, acerola cherry juice can substitute for blood. Battle Aura: Whenever she participates in a hololive tournament, particularly aMario Kartgame, her avatar will exude an aura around her.
